editorial.blurb: Milt's proves that kosher barbecue can be as bold and smoky as any traditional BBQ joint, with tender low-and-slow smoked meats and sides that rival the mains.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the "Milt's Way" Burger or Smoked Brisket Sandwich and don't skip the brisket chili fries—they're legendary. The pickles are also considered some of the best in the city.
